title: rarebert
description: AI-powered notification daemon. on hold until there is time to port it to OpenCode V2.

content.heading: rarebert - the AI-driven development loop
content: **rarebert** is a self-modifying scripting environment for interactive, AI-driven development.

content.heading: the loop it lives in
content: the environment pairs **opencode** with your editor and git: the model implements, the diff is summarized, the result runs, and what happened is remembered.
$EDITOR and opencode sit side by side over the same module tree; every cycle ends in a commit.

content.heading: the package, architecturally
content: a TypeScript runtime (`lib/runtime/` + bun) that orchestrates $EDITOR, git, and opencode, and a memo subsystem that threads observations between the model and your shell.
each turn ends in a commit, so the working tree is always clean before the next cycle.

content.heading: stable so far - v1.0.0
content: the manifest declares 1.0.0; the tags and the OpenCode V2 port are still ahead - the page stays up, the tool stays on hold.
